blocking_permission_gap.reason: Exact pinned official docs say UEPseudo code is subject to Epic Games licensing terms. The private submodule license and applicable compiled redistribution grant were not accessible/established. Main MIT is not a substitute.

Pinned Cargo.lock packages are a conservative 73-package inventory, not exact Windows linked SBOM; upstream CMake does not visibly request --locked.
